d: Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav unveiled the party's 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly election manifesto titled Jan-Man Manifesto 2027: PDA Ka Pran Patra, in Lucknow on Constitution Day, announcing free domestic and farm electricity, a ₹5,000 monthly allowance for unemployed graduates, a statewide caste census, and legal MSP guarantees.
